chat.title: Ask the corpus
chat.placeholder: Ask a question about the countries in the corpus…
chat.intro: EasyRag answers from a fixed corpus of 195 country profiles (CIA World Factbook), citing its sources. Try one of these:
examples: What language is spoken in Brazil?
What is the capital of Japan?
chat.incomplete: The connection dropped before the answer finished.

error.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.throttled: Too many requests — wait a moment and try again.
error.server: The server hit an error generating the answer.

hero.title: A RAG you can actually see working
hero.subtitle: A fixed corpus, indexed into pgvector, answered by a local model with citations. No API keys, no login.

featuresSection.title: How it works
featuresSection.subtitle: Ingestion, retrieval and generation, end to end.

performance.title: Local embeddings
performance.description: Documents are chunked and embedded with a local sentence-transformers model.

security.title: Vector search
security.description: Questions are matched against the corpus with pgvector cosine similarity.

deployment.title: Grounded answers
deployment.description: A local Ollama model answers from the retrieved passages and cites them.
